smtp_db.title: Custom SMTP + Database
smtp_db.intro: Use your SMTP provider settings and store credentials encrypted in the database.

steps.title: Collect SMTP details
paragraphs: Copy your SMTP host, port, encryption method, and authentication credentials from your provider dashboard.

steps.title: Configure in Boolean SMTP
paragraphs: Choose Credential Storage: Database, enter Host and Port, then set encryption and Auto TLS.

steps.title: Enable authentication if required
paragraphs: Set Authentication to On only if your provider requires it, then enter username and SMTP password.

steps.title: Save and test
paragraphs: Save the connection and send a test email to verify credentials and connectivity.

smtp_wp_config.title: Custom SMTP + wp-config.php
smtp_wp_config.intro: Keep SMTP secrets outside the database by defining constants in wp-config.php.

steps.title: Copy constants from the form
paragraphs: Switch Credential Storage to WP Config and copy the generated BOOLEANSMTP_SMTP_* constants.

steps.title: Add constants to wp-config.php
paragraphs: Paste and update the values in wp-config.php on your WordPress host, then keep Authentication aligned with your constants.

steps.title: Confirm and save
paragraphs: Check the confirmation box in the form and save the connection.

steps.title: Run a test email
paragraphs: Send a test email to ensure the constants and SMTP endpoint are configured correctly.
